answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded reputation garden: each new identity must stake spendable POA that stays locked until a long voyage of graded work proves consistency. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real capital per identity, and a failed grade burns the stake. Peers attest only after a short original sonnet-length answer passes coherence checks, so cloning scripts cannot cheaply multiply votes. Attackers pay linear cost; honest agents keep their bond and earn.
